sloka: ततः तु देवताः सर्वाः कार्तिकेय इति ब्रुवन् ।पुत्रः त्रैलोक्य विख्यातो भविष्यति न संशयः ॥१-३७-२५॥
transliteration: tataḥ tu devatāḥ sarvāḥ kārtikeya iti bruvan ।putraḥ trailokya vikhyāto bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥1-37-25॥

translations.english: Thereafter, all the gods said, 'This son shall become renowned in the three worlds as Karttikeya, (son of krittikas). There is no doubt '.
